title: Article 227 and the Commercial Courts Act
description: The power of superintendence conferred on the High Courts of India by Article 227 of the Constitution of India occupies a unique and inviolable position in the legal fabric of the nation.Article 227 represents a constitutional mandate vesting in every High Court the plenary power of judicial supervision, thereby ensuring that every judicial body be kept within the bounds of its authority.
